rest.$description: Fill of a primary button: the main action of a view, at most one per group.

hover.$description: Fill of a primary button on hover.

pressed.$description: Fill of a primary button while pressed.

content.$description: Label, icons, and spinner of a primary button, in every state but disabled.

rest.$description: Fill of a secondary button: every other action next to the primary one.

hover.$description: Fill of a secondary button on hover.

pressed.$description: Fill of a secondary button while pressed.

content.$description: Label, icons, and spinner of a secondary button, in every state but disabled.

border.$description: Outline of a secondary button, which sets it apart on a surface of the same fill. Decorative: the label identifies the button.

hover.$description: Fill of a ghost button on hover. At rest a ghost button is transparent.

pressed.$description: Fill of a ghost button while pressed.

content.$description: Label, icons, and spinner of a ghost button: low-emphasis and repeated actions, in every state but disabled.

rest.$description: Fill of a danger button: destructive actions such as delete or remove.

hover.$description: Fill of a danger button on hover.

pressed.$description: Fill of a danger button while pressed.

content.$description: Label, icons, and spinner of a danger button, in every state but disabled.

surface.$description: Fill of a disabled button of any variant but ghost, which stays transparent.

content.$description: Label and icons of a disabled button of any variant.

border.$description: Outline of a disabled secondary button.

height.$description: Height of small buttons, and the width of an icon-only one.

base.$description: Horizontal padding of small buttons on a side without an icon.

icon-side.$description: Horizontal padding of small buttons on a side with an icon: one padding step less, since an icon reads heavier than text.

gap.$description: Space between the icon and the label of small buttons.

icon.$description: Icon and spinner size of small buttons.

label.$description: Label text style of small buttons.

height.$description: Height of default (md) buttons, and the width of an icon-only one.

base.$description: Horizontal padding of default (md) buttons on a side without an icon.

icon-side.$description: Horizontal padding of default (md) buttons on a side with an icon: one padding step less, since an icon reads heavier than text.

gap.$description: Space between the icon and the label of default (md) buttons.

icon.$description: Icon and spinner size of default (md) buttons.

label.$description: Label text style of default (md) buttons.

height.$description: Height of large buttons, and the width of an icon-only one.

base.$description: Horizontal padding of large buttons on a side without an icon.

icon-side.$description: Horizontal padding of large buttons on a side with an icon: one padding step less, since an icon reads heavier than text.

gap.$description: Space between the icon and the label of large buttons.

icon.$description: Icon and spinner size of large buttons.

label.$description: Label text style of large buttons.

radius.$description: Corner radius of every button, the same as inputs and selects so a row of controls has the same corners.

border-width.$description: Border width every button reserves, so all variants have the same box. Transparent unless the variant has an outline.
